client.title: Public configs, config sharing and custom themes
client.summary: Share setups with the community and make the menu yours.
items: Public configs tab pulls shared setups straight from our GitHub
Pulled configs are temporary and removed on every relaunch
Import / Export your whole setup as JSON through the clipboard
Custom theme editor with accent and background colour pickers

client.title: Cleanup and a lighter Name Hider
client.summary: Fewer duplicates and less work per frame.
items: Duplicate Aspect Ratio and the old Crosshair were removed (49 modules)
Name Hider now reacts to text changes instead of scanning the whole UI
Slider values loaded from configs are clamped to their allowed range

client.title: Friends protection and menu fixes
client.summary: Friends are safe from more of your own attacks.
items: A universal attack guard skips friends on every attack press
Back button rebuilt as a fixed-size pill
Performance pass on shared target lookups

client.title: Prestige Client 2.0
client.summary: The first public build of the Roblox edition.
items: Hit Sound dropdown with 25 sounds that replace the game's own
Icons and sounds load from GitHub instead of being embedded
Combat, Mace, Misc, Movement, Spear and Visual module tabs

loader.title: Prestige Launcher
loader.summary: Boot to the launcher, then inject when you are ready.
items: Release notes and the client link are fetched from GitHub
Environment checks and a live injection log
Falls back to bundled notes when GitHub is unreachable
